question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster. 

RAILCAR : NEEPYEN :: ICESHOW : _______.
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Alternate - 4 and + 4 letters in the given word.**

RAILCAR : NEEPYEN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b80bef30c216c94bd80010e9b72b8c383d5a7ac2ec3fac8252e4fe6010a7187.png] 

Similarly,

**ICESHOW : _______.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/626e90d9156f145e3dfa59fa70c6fe3062a7d46038327da315386de16e3ccfd5.png] 

Hence, 'ICESHOW' is coded as "**EGAWDSS**".
